Why: ruff 0.16.3 cannot express the nested forms. compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
Two whole-tree AST scans duplicate rules that ruff's `flake8-tidy-imports` expresses natively, and ruff runs on every `make lint` and pre-commit. The first is `tests/unit/test_tests_import_convention.py::test_no_tests_rooted_imports_anywhere_under_tests` (bug a371: no `tests.`-rooted import anywhere under `tests/`). The second is `tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py::test_no_core_module_imports_heavy_stack_at_module_scope` (no module-scope import of the 15 heavy stacks under `src/rebar` outside `_engine`). The other import scans in table (5) cannot be expressed in ruff and STAY. Ruff is pinned at `ruff==0.16.3`.

Measured equivalence on ruff 0.16.3, comparing the deleted scan with ruff over the same cases (transcripts on this ticket):
- TID251 matches the a371 scan on all 17 import forms tried, including `import tests.x`, `from tests import x`, `from tests.x import y`, relative and in-function imports.
- TID253 matches the heavy scan on 10 of 20 forms. It fires on flat module-level `import x`, `import x as y`, `from x import y` and submodule forms (`import opentelemetry.trace`, `from opentelemetry.trace import y`). It does not fire on a heavy import nested in a module-level `try` body, `except` handler, `finally`, `if`, `else`, `with`, `for`, `while`, `match` case, or `if TYPE_CHECKING:`. The deleted scan flagged all 10. This is by design in ruff 0.16.3: `banned_module_level_imports` returns early unless `semantic.at_top_level()`, which ruff defines as module scope "and not nested within any statements", and there is no option to change it.
- No other gate in `make verify` covers those 10 forms tree-wide. The clean-wheel `scripts/check_import_walk.py` (CI artifact probe only) catches a nested import that executes and is not swallowed, but misses the guarded `try: import httpx` / `except ImportError:` idiom and branches that do not run. `test_lean_workflow_runtime_pulls_no_heavy_stack` sees only the 212 modules the lean runtime loads, of 654 outside `_engine`.
- The current tree has 0 nested heavy imports.

Following the rule this epic already applies (what ruff cannot express stays), the nested half of the heavy scan stays as a narrower residual test. The flat half moves to TID253. No form is checked by both: on the 20 forms, ruff plus the residual reproduces the deleted scan with 0 mismatches and 0 forms flagged twice.

## Approach
- `pyproject.toml`: add `"TID251"` and `"TID253"` to `[tool.ruff.lint] select`. Add `[tool.ruff.lint.flake8-tidy-imports]` with `banned-module-level-imports` = the 15 stacks (`langchain`, `langgraph`, `langchain_anthropic`, `langchain_openai`, `langchain_mcp_adapters`, `langfuse`, `anthropic`, `deepagents`, `opentelemetry`, `pydantic_ai`, `httpx`, `tree_sitter`, `tree_sitter_language_pack`, `hcl2`, `lark`). Add `[tool.ruff.lint.flake8-tidy-imports.banned-api]` with `"tests".msg` carrying the bug a371 reason. In per-file-ignores, add `"src/rebar/_engine/**" = ["TID253"]` and extend `"tests/**"` and `"scripts/**"` to `["T201", "TID253"]`. `ignore` stays the RUF trio, and nothing is added under `extend-ignore` (`test_ruff_ratchet.py` enforces both).
- `tests/unit/test_tests_import_convention.py`: delete `test_no_tests_rooted_imports_anywhere_under_tests`, `_tests_rooted_imports` and the import of `_tree_scan` it leaves unused. Keep `test_audit_page_modules_collect_under_bare_pytest` (the bug a371 repro).
- `tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py`: `_HEAVY` is read from `pyproject.toml` via `tomllib`, so the list has one source. Replace `test_no_core_module_imports_heavy_stack_at_module_scope` and `_module_scope_imports` with `test_no_core_module_imports_heavy_stack_nested_at_module_scope` and `_nested_module_scope_imports`. The new helper yields only imports inside a module-level `if`/`try`/`try*`/`with`/`for`/`while`/`match` body, branch, handler or `finally`. Flat top-level imports are left to TID253, and function and class bodies are not entered. `_is_heavy` stays (exact name or `name.`-prefixed submodule). `if TYPE_CHECKING:` stays flagged, as in the deleted scan. `try*` is new: the deleted scan skipped it. `import ast` and `from _tree_scan import parsed_python_files` stay in use, so no import becomes unused.
- `tests/unit/test_ruff_ratchet.py`: 4 tests pin the fold so the list cannot be emptied silently. Both codes stay selected, the banned list is exactly the 15 stacks, the `tests` ban keeps its a371 message, and TID253 is exempt only for `tests/**`, `scripts/**` and `src/rebar/_engine/**`.
- `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py` is unchanged: `test_core_optionality.py` still collects 3 tests, so `_OPTIONALITY_SUITE_ITEM_COUNT` stays 10.
- Every scan table (5) marks STAYS is untouched.

## Scope
In scope: `pyproject.toml`, `tests/unit/test_tests_import_convention.py`, `tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py`, `tests/unit/test_ruff_ratchet.py`. Out of scope: every STAYS scan, every file under `src/` and `scripts/`, and `.github/*-baseline.json`. Expected census: `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` reports the same counts as on `origin/main`, because no `tests/_*.py` helper, check script, workflow step, autouse fixture, lock, env var or config key is added.

## Testing
RED proofs, each run and its transcript recorded on this ticket. Each scratch file is removed afterwards.
1. TID251: `printf 'from tests.unit.nothing import x\n' > tests/unit/test_e10_red_tid251.py && ruff check tests/unit/test_e10_red_tid251.py` gives one `TID251`.
2. TID253 flat: `import httpx` and `import opentelemetry.trace` in `src/rebar/_e10_red.py` each give one `TID253`. The same import inside a `def` is clean.
3. Residual: for each of the 11 nested forms (try body, except handler, finally, if, else, with, for, while, match case, `if TYPE_CHECKING:`, `try*` handler), write the heavy import into `src/rebar/_e10_red.py` and run `pytest tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py::test_no_core_module_imports_heavy_stack_nested_at_module_scope`. It FAILS naming `_e10_red.py`. A flat `import httpx` and an in-function import leave it passing.
4. Ratchet: 4 mutations of `pyproject.toml` (drop a code, empty the list, drop the a371 message, widen an exemption) each fail exactly their own `test_ruff_ratchet.py` test.
Then `make verify` passes apart from the 17 known arm64 pandoc failures under `tests/unit/reconciler/`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `ruff check --select TID251,TID253 src tests scripts` exits 0.
- [ ] The RED-proof transcripts (TID251 fires; TID253 fires on flat and submodule imports and is silent in a function; the residual fails on each of the 11 nested forms and passes on flat and in-function imports; each of the 4 ratchet mutations fails its test) are on this ticket, and `tests/unit/test_e10_red_tid251.py` and `src/rebar/_e10_red.py` are absent from the tree.
